name: Rhykker
noteEs: Rhykker es el creator de Diablo con audiencia más amplia — channel grande con cobertura de news, patch reactions, tier lists agregadas y eventos. Su tono es accesible y mainstream, lo que hace su content ideal para newcomers que quieren panorama general sin meterse en theorycraft profundo. Cubre la franchise Diablo entera (D2R, D3, D4, expansiones).
noteEn: Rhykker is the Diablo creator with the broadest audience — large channel with coverage of news, patch reactions, aggregated tier lists, and events. His tone is accessible and mainstream, making his content ideal for newcomers wanting a general picture without diving into deep theorycraft. Covers the entire Diablo franchise (D2R, D3, D4, expansions).
highlightsEs: Channel con mayor audiencia del Diablo space
Cobertura news + patch reactions con cadencia rápida
Tier lists agregadas presentadas de forma accesible
Cobre franchise entera incluyendo D2R y expansiones D4
highlightsEn: Largest-audience channel in the Diablo space
Covers the entire franchise including D2R and D4 expansions
